purpose: Teach: 書き手/読み上げ/意気込み/組み合わせる/梱包/別紙/試料/春休み

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 若手の書き手、社内報、活用しよう。
lines.en: Let's make sure we're leveraging our junior writers for the company newsletter.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Calm but directive. Professional ease — she's thought this through. Slight emphasis on 'writers' as the resource. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。式典で、創業者の言葉、読み上げます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be reading the founder's remarks at the ceremony.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive. A quiet pride in the assignment — not boastful, just clear-eyed about the responsibility. Slightly slower on 'remarks.' Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新企画への意気込み、感じる発表だったね。
lines.en: That presentation really conveyed the energy we want around this new project.
lines.style: Warm and observant. Quick, genuine appreciation — this is what works. Slight upward lilt on 'energy,' as if she's still caught in the momentum. Forward-leaning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。グッズ、複数アイテム、組み合わせる戦略、検討中です。
lines.en: Right now we're looking at how to bundle multiple products together as part of the strategy.
lines.style: Professional update tone. Measured, methodical. Neutral-warm — he's giving information, not asking for approval. Slight pause before 'strategy' to signal it's a bigger piece.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発送、梱包資材、エコ仕様にしよう。
lines.en: Let's switch the shipping packaging to eco-friendly materials.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. A decision she's already made, spoken as a suggestion. Slight emphasis on 'eco-friendly' — this matters. Calm, authoritative without being cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書、付録は別紙添付です。
lines.en: Yes. The proposal draft with all the attachments is ready to go.
lines.style: Efficient, competent. A small note of readiness — everything is in order. Quiet confidence. No overselling, just stating what's done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 試料、品質保証部に、送付済み?
lines.en: Have the samples been sent to the quality assurance team yet?
lines.style: Focused check-in. Light expectation embedded in the question — she assumes yes but is verifying. Brisk, direct. No edge, just necessary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。春休み中も、対応可能な体制です。
lines.en: Yes, and we've made sure there's coverage even during spring break so we won't miss anything.
lines.style: Assuring wrap-up. Quiet pride in the planning — he's thought ahead. Warm, reliable. Slightly slower on 'spring break,' showing he's aware of the constraint. Small exhale of completion.
